name: Skins
author: Lyle Mills
description: Struck membrane modes move from a round open head to a tighter loaded skin, with centre, rim, damping and pitch-dive control.

controls.label: Membrane
controls.description: Retensions the mode ratios from a round open head toward a tighter loaded skin.

controls.label: Strike
controls.description: Moves the strike from the centre's low body toward a bright rim slap.

controls.label: Damping
controls.description: Opens the head from a short muted knock to a long resonant ring.

controls.label: Pressure
controls.description: Adds hand pressure: stronger pitch dive and faster loss of the upper modes.

outputs.main: Mono: the full membrane and strike. Stereo: the left membrane pickup.
outputs.aux: Mono: rim-weighted upper modes and dry slap. Stereo: the right membrane pickup.

trigger: Strikes the membrane and restarts its downward pitch bend.
